main_measure.name: pooled slope of next-day excess return on post_pipeline_value, mean_reversion bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 and supporting mean > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2 or supporting mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 distinct days with regime bars

supporting_check.name: mean of sign(forecast) x next-day excess return, top third by |forecast|

decided_by: Confirm: the slope is positive with t = 3.31 >= 2 and the supporting check's mean is above 0.
reading: Width is recomputed per window as range > mean range of the previous 20 bars (from prices, or from last_history_value where the window has under 20 prior bars); the slope is OLS with intercept and day-clustered standard error (scores summed per UTC day, G/(G-1) correction); the supporting check uses the floor(n/3) regime bars with the largest |forecast| and a day-clustered t of the mean; the day count is the distinct UTC days of regime bars with a valid forecast value and next-day return.

direction_check.why: main measure +9.741e-05 on the check folds against +0.0002371 on every fold
